capabilities: draw per-habit line charts showing minutes as percent of a daily goal
switch between a month calendar view and a 12-month average year view
mark habit handovers with from/to dates and dashed transition labels
configure charts with a habits code block and YAML options
show hover tooltips with minutes, goal and percentage
extras: Privacy is stated explicitly: no network requests, telemetry, or accounts. Interface is available in English, German, Hungarian, and Ukrainian. A longer example lives in examples/dashboard.md.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize habit values recorded in daily-note frontmatter as percentage-of-goal charts.
summary: Renders daily habit progress line charts, as percent of a goal, from frontmatter fields in daily notes.
